source.name: LaunchLoom owned design study
source.rightsEvidence: This is a LaunchLoom-owned original design study and its in-house rendered capture, stored for internal inspiration and implementation research.

heroGeometry.viewport: warm full-width opening with an asymmetrical image cluster

navigationGeometry.placement: small linear top row with utility CTA
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact top row with inline action

typography.scale: large conversational headline with compact utility labels

imageTreatment.crop: varied rectangular crops with collage overlap

servicePresentation.interaction: quiet row hover and seasonal highlight

rules: stack product stills into an intentional offset stack
turn shelf rows into full-width touch targets
keep the visit action visible without overlaying copy

requiredSignatureElements.description: graphic band that moves visitors toward a visit or order
overlapping product stills with varied crops

acceptanceChecks: hero uses a loose product collage rather than a symmetric split
services read as seasonal shelf rows
a graphic visit or order band appears before the closing contact
mobile keeps the collage relationship while stacking safely
referenceDna.annotatedDescription: Owned LaunchLoom design study used as visual evidence. Original LaunchLoom study informed by multiple hospitality references.

review.scope: paired full-page evidence and transferable visual mechanics; not approval of sample business claims or production copy
